purpose: Machine-readable consolidation of the current TL2 Tactical Computer, Sensor, ECM, and ECCM working candidates supported by Checkpoints 79a, 80, and 81a.

referenceEnvironment.degradedFireGuardrail: Firm restoration through appropriate ECCM remains materially more effective than the -25 Approximate-track fallback.
referenceEnvironment.tallViabilityGuardrail: Advanced systems may create real power pressure but must broaden viable design choices rather than become systematic self-traps.

explicitNonPromotions: No complete TL2 production combat profile is created by this file.
No TL2 Sensor physical-range increase is promoted.
No TL2 reactor-output increase is promoted.
No new TL2 Sensor/ECM/ECCM overload mode is promoted.
No weapon is granted degraded fire merely because the Tactical Computer supports the penalty.
Ordinary missile Firm-terminal rules remain unchanged.
historicalCompatibility: Historical study/runtime identifiers named tl2-production are retained for reproducibility and are not current design authority merely because of their identifier.
